notes: Spec asserts: (1) Session appears in ready within 1s of agent launch and (2) PID bound within 1s. Both phases anchor UNPINNED to recording start (agent launch) with a 1000ms budget. Hermes writes no transcript file — one shared SQLite store at $HERMES_HOME/state.db — and its sessions row is INSERTed only ~2s after launch, on the first user message. The <1s birth is therefore carried by the proc-<PID> pre-session the process scanner mints from the CommandPattern match, exactly as in opencode's verified sibling cell; the store-backed session (id <YYYYMMDD>_<HHMMSS>_<hex>) reconciles a couple of seconds later and supersedes it. NO observations block: `of verify`'s metric assertions read ONLY the replay golden summary, and neither tokens nor cost can reach it for hermes (hermes' Parser sets no token/cost fields; those come from ComputeMetrics over the store, which replay never runs, and the store-derived token lift in cmd/replay/metrics.go is gated to antigravity). Matches the recorded, verified opencode 1.1 sibling, which also carries no observations block. `record` re-adds `model` from the real golden once one exists. UPDATE (record, 2026-08-02): the golden now EXISTS — the driver gained a store→JSONL exporter (b55e6bb) — so this spec does what its own last sentence asked and pins model from it. summary.model_name reads 'gpt-5.6-luna' in recording 2026-08-02-23-08-56_irrlichd-0.5.9+813a683, and applyHardAssertions compares it by exact string, so a re-record under a HERMES_HOME whose config.yaml carries a different model.default WILL hard-fail here — that is the pin working, not drift. tokens and cost stay unpinned: the exporter did not change where they live (the sessions AGGREGATE row, read only by ComputeMetrics, which replay never runs), and this recording's golden confirms it with cum_input=cum_output=0. Note 2-1_basic-turn deliberately leaves model UNPINNED per #440 on the same column; the two cells disagree and that is a maintainer call, not something this run settled.
